cases.title: Initiate Drag Event and Capture Product Data
cases.description: Verify that dragging a product item (li element with draggable='true' and data-testid='product-item-1') correctly initiates a drag event and captures the corresponding product title and price.

cases.title: Drop Product into Drop Area and Update Cart Display
cases.description: Verify that dropping a product item into the designated drop area (id='div1', data-testid='drop-area') successfully adds it to the cart and updates the cart display (.box1 for quantity, .box2 for title, and .box3 for unit price), supporting both new and repeated products.

cases.title: Calculate and Display Total Cart Price
cases.description: Verify that the system correctly sums the prices of all products in the cart, formats the total to two decimal places with the currency symbol, and displays it in the <div id='allMoney'> element.

opinions.feedback: The proposed high-level test cases are well-structured, distinct, and directly cover all provided requirements without any identified blockers or gaps.
All cases accurately test the stated requirements, follow valid identifiers, and correctly align with the provided specifications. No blockers found.

analysis.analysis: Requirement e2edev_bench_01-R-1: Testable behaviors include initiating a drag event on draggable li elements, capturing product title and price. Boundaries are set by data-testid attributes (product-item-N, product-title-N, product-price-N). Normal paths involve dragging valid product items. Abnormal paths include dragging non-draggable elements or items missing title/price attributes. Ambiguities include the specific data transfer format (e.g., text/plain or JSON). Requirement e2edev_bench_01-R-3: Testable behaviors include dropping items into drop-area (id='div1', data-testid='drop-area'), updating cart display (.box1 for quantity, .box2 for title, .box3 for unit price), and handling repeated products. Boundaries involve valid drop targets vs. outside areas. Normal paths are dropping single or multiple distinct/repeated products. Abnormal paths include dropping invalid elements or dropping outside the designated drop area. Ambiguities include how quantities increment for repeated products. Requirement e2edev_bench_01-R-5: Testable behaviors include summing all cart item prices, formatting to two decimal places with currency symbol, and displaying in #allMoney. Boundaries include empty cart (should display $0.00 or equivalent) and large sums. Normal paths involve accurate summation of mixed prices. Abnormal paths include corrupted price strings. Ambiguities include whether currency symbol handling is dynamic or hardcoded to '$'.
